body: My note from near lunchtime: the field trial crew carried sealed seed packet. my brother started coughing. I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.
title: Near lunchtime: sealed seed packet
gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

body:
At closing I counted the remaining boxes and wrote the number on the lid. A driver came for them after I had put away the register.

He had a list of addresses, but it was folded so I could only see the first. He crossed it out without unloading anything. We waited until his radio called him away.

I was told to write the boxes off as spoiled. They were still warm when he took them, and I had eaten from the same batch.
title: Back door count
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
